$comment: NFR-14 safety word check allowlist. Each entry exempts one ARB key from one rule for the listed words only, and needs a reason a reviewer can check. Only the rules in ALLOWLISTABLE_RULES (scripts/check-safety-words.mjs) can be allowlisted, and never an override word on a string that carries Tidak aman / Not safe or Cek label / Check the label. Each entry pins the exact reviewed text per locale in `values`: if the string changes, the check fails until the entry is reviewed again and its values updated. An entry that no longer matches a finding fails the check, so remove it when the string no longer needs it. Changes need qa-engineer and ux-designer review.
